source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 16 (PDF 57-72), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 16 (Human Endocrine System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define hormone.
(Hormone ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Hormone aik regulatory chemical hai jo endocrine gland khoon ya tissue fluid mein kharij karta hai. Khoon ise har cell tak le jata hai magar yeh asar sirf apne target cells mein dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: A hormone is a regulatory chemical that is secreted into the blood or tissue fluid by an endocrine gland

blocks.prompt:
2 What is chemical coordination?
(Chemical coordination kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Endocrine system growth, metabolism aur reproduction jaise lambe amal target hisson ko hormones ki shakal mein kimiyai hidayat bhej kar control karta hai. Ise chemical coordination kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: It is called chemical coordination

blocks.prompt:
3 What are target cells? How does a hormone change their activity?
(Target cells kya hain? Hormone in ki activity kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Target cells woh cells hain jin par koi khas hormone asar karta hai; in mein receptors hote hain, har receptor aik makhsoos hormone se jurta hai. Jurne se cell ke andar tabdeeli laane wale waqiaat shuru hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Target cells have receptors

blocks.prompt:
4 Differentiate between hormones and neurotransmitters.
(Hormones aur neurotransmitters mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono chemical messengers hain, magar farq yeh hai.

book_ref.quote: However, hormones are part of endocrine system, while neurotransmitters are part of nervous system

rows: Endocrine system ka hissa
Nervous system ka hissa
Aksar dheere asar
Tez asar
Lamba asar
Chhota asar

blocks.prompt:
5 Name the main chemical categories of hormones with one example of each.
(Hormones ki bari kimiyai qismon ke naam aik aik misal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Chaar qismein: 1. Peptide aur protein hormones, misal insulin. 2. Glycoprotein hormones, misal TSH. 3. Amino acid derivatives, misal thyroxine. 4. Steroid hormones, misal cortisol.

book_ref.quote: hormones are grouped into four main chemical categories

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab pehle 'teen' qismein likhti hai magar khud chaar bayan karti hai; is liye sahi jawab chaar qismein hai (Book correction).

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between peptide/protein hormones and steroid hormones.
(Peptide/protein hormones aur steroid hormones mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: In ki kimiyai fitrat aur cell tak pahunchne ka tareeqa mukhtalif hai.

book_ref.quote: This means they can move through the cell membrane to give instructions directly to the nucleus

rows: Amino acids ki zanjeeron se bane
Cholesterol (lipid) se bane
Water-soluble
Lipid-soluble
Cell membrane se nahi guzarte
Cell membrane se guzar jate hain
Cell ki satah ke receptors se jurte hain
Seedha nucleus ko hidayat dete hain
Misal insulin, glucagon
Misal cortisol, testosterone

blocks.prompt:
7 What are glycoprotein hormones? Give two examples.
(Glycoprotein hormones kya hain? Do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Glycoproteins conjugated proteins hain: protein ke saath carbohydrate (shakar) group. Yeh bare, pecheeda, polar molecules hain jo membrane se nahi guzarte. Misalein: TSH, FSH, LH (anterior pituitary).

book_ref.quote: They consist of a protein combined with a carbohydrate (sugar) group

blocks.prompt:
8 Why can some amino acid derivative hormones cross cell membranes and others cannot?
(Kuch amino acid derivative hormones membrane se guzar jate hain aur kuch nahi, kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh is par munhasir hai ke woh protein jaisa rawayya rakhte hain ya lipid jaisa. Epinephrine aur norepinephrine nahi guzarte, jabke thyroxine aur tri-iodothyronine guzar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Their ability to pass through cell membranes depends on whether they behave more like a protein or more like a lipid

blocks.prompt:
9 How was the first hormone discovered?
(Pehla hormone kaise daryaft hua?)
blocks.explanation: 1902 mein Bayliss aur Starling ne digestive system par tehqeeq mein dekha ke tezabi gastric juice small intestine mein aaye to aik maddah (secretin) khoon mein kharij hota hai. Yeh pancreas tak ja kar pancreatic juice kharij karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: They found that when acidic gastric juice comes in small intestine

blocks.prompt:
10 Name four steroid hormones and their sources.
(Chaar steroid hormones aur un ke source ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: 1. Cortisol: adrenal cortex. 2. Aldosterone: adrenal cortex. 3. Testosterone: testes. 4. Estrogen / progesterone: ovaries.

book_ref.quote: Regulate the female reproductive system and cycle.

blocks.prompt:
11 What does the human endocrine system consist of?
(Insani endocrine system kis par mushtamil hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh un glands aur organs par mushtamil hai jo jism ke kaam regulate karne ke liye hormones banate aur kharij karte hain, maslan hypothalamus, pituitary, thyroid, parathyroid, pancreas, adrenals aur gonads.

book_ref.quote: The endocrine system of human beings consists of glands and organs that produce and secrete hormones

blocks.prompt:
12 Differentiate between releasing hormones and inhibiting hormones of the hypothalamus.
(Hypothalamus ke releasing aur inhibiting hormones mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hypothalamus se khoon ki naliyon ke zariye anterior pituitary tak jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Inhibiting hormones inhibit production and secretion of anterior pituitary hormones.

rows: Anterior pituitary ko hormones banane aur kharij karne par ubharte hain
Anterior pituitary ke hormones ko rokte hain
Misal growth hormone releasing-hormone (GH ka ikhraj)
Misal somatostatin (GH ki rokthaam)

blocks.prompt:
13 What is prolactin inhibiting factor? Write its effect.
(Prolactin inhibiting factor kya hai? Is ka asar likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh hypothalamus ka hormone hai jo asal mein dopamine hai. Yeh anterior pituitary se prolactin ka ikhraj rokta hai.

book_ref.quote: Prolactin inhibiting factor – which is actually dopamine

blocks.prompt:
14 Name the hypothalamic hormones that cause secretion of TSH, ACTH, and FSH and LH.
(Hypothalamus ke un hormones ke naam likhein jo TSH, ACTH aur FSH-LH ka ikhraj karwate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
1. TSH: thyrotropin releasing hormone (TRH).
2. ACTH: adreno-corticotropin releasing hormone.
3. FSH aur LH: gonadotropin releasing hormone.

book_ref.quote: Adreno-corticotropin releasing hormone

blocks.prompt:
15 Differentiate between the control of anterior pituitary and posterior pituitary by the hypothalamus.
(Hypothalamus ke anterior aur posterior pituitary par control mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus dono lobes ko mukhtalif tareeqon se control karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Two hormones i.e., oxytocin and antidiuretic hormone (ADH) are made by neurosecretory cells of hypothalamus

rows: Hypothalamus se khoon ki naliyon ke zariye jura
Hormones neurosecretory cells ke axons se aate hain
Releasing aur inhibiting hormones is ke hormones control karte hain
Hypothalamus ke banaye oxytocin aur ADH yahan jama hote hain
Apne hormones khud banata aur kharij karta hai
Sirf jama hormones khoon mein chhorta hai

blocks.prompt:
16 What is the infundibulum? Name the lobes of the pituitary gland.
(Infundibulum kya hai? Pituitary gland ke lobes ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Infundibulum woh dandi hai jo pituitary ko hypothalamus se jorti hai. Pituitary ke teen lobes hain: anterior, posterior aur intermediate (median).

book_ref.quote: Pituitary gland is attached to hypothalamus by a stalk called infundibulum

blocks.prompt:
17 Write two functions of growth hormone.
(Growth hormone ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Muscles, haddiyon (bilwasta) aur doosre tissues ki growth tez karta hai.
2. Sahi metabolic nizam ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It is also essential for proper metabolic regulation

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the function of ACTH?
(ACTH ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ACTH (corticotropin) adrenal cortex ko corticosteroids kharij karne par ubharta hai jo glucose aur namak ka tawazun regulate karte hain.

book_ref.quote: stimulates the adrenal cortex for the secretion of corticosteroids

blocks.prompt:
19 Differentiate between FSH and LH.
(FSH aur LH mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono anterior pituitary ke gonadotropins hain.

book_ref.quote: In females, it stimulates ovaries to produce progesterone and estrogen hormones

rows: Auraton mein ovarian follicles ki nashonuma
Ovaries se progesterone aur estrogen banwana; ovulation shuru karna
Mardon mein sperms ki nashonuma
Testes se testosterone banwana

blocks.prompt:
20 Differentiate between the roles of prolactin and oxytocin in milk.
(Doodh ke silsile mein prolactin aur oxytocin ke kirdar mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik doodh banata hai, doosra nikalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Prolactin stimulates the mammary glands to produce milk

rows: Anterior pituitary ka hormone
Posterior pituitary chhorta hai (hypothalamus banata hai)
Mammary glands mein doodh banwata hai
Smooth muscles sukerh kar doodh nikalwata hai

blocks.prompt:
21 Why is growth hormone treatment not suitable for every short person?
(Growth hormone ka ilaj har chhote qad wale ke liye munasib kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: GH ka ilaj un bachon ki growth barhata hai jin ka qad GH ki kami se chhota ho. Magar har dwarf mein GH ki kami nahi hoti, is liye yeh har aik ke liye munasib nahi.

book_ref.quote: GH treatment is given to children have short stature due to GH deficiency

blocks.prompt:
22 Write a note on the intermediate pituitary.
(Intermediate pituitary par note likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Insanon mein yeh anterior aur posterior pituitary ke darmiyan cells ki patli teh hai. Yeh MSH banata hai jo jild aur baalon ke melanocytes se melanin banwata aur kharij karwata hai.

book_ref.quote: In humans, intermediate pituitary is a thin layer of cells between the anterior and posterior pituitary

blocks.prompt:
23 Differentiate between gigantism and acromegaly.
(Gigantism aur acromegaly mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono growth hormone ki zyadti se hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Over-secretion of GH in adult life causes acromegaly

rows: Barhte bache mein GH ki zyadti
Baaligh umr mein GH ki zyadti
Qad aam se bohat zyada
Haddiyan lambai mein nahi, motai mein barhti hain
Bare haath, paon aur chehre ke nuqoosh
Bare haath, paon, khopri, naak aur jabra

blocks.prompt:
24 What is dwarfism? How is it different from cretinism?
(Dwarfism kya hai? Yeh cretinism se kaise mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dwarfism GH ki kami se hota hai: nashonuma aahista aur qad chhota, magar hisse mutanasib aur dimagh/IQ par asar nahi. Cretinism (janeen/bachpan mein hypothyroidism) mein growth ruk jati hai aur zehni pasmandgi bhi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Deficiency of GH results in dwarfism in which development is much slower and individual has short stature

blocks.prompt:
25 What are the effects of over- and under-secretion of TSH?
(TSH ki zyadti aur kami ke kya asraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: TSH ki zyadti hyperthyroidism (thyroxine ki zyadti) aur kami hypothyroidism (thyroxine ki kami) paida karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Over secretion of TSH causes hyperthyroidism

blocks.prompt:
26 Why does the posterior pituitary not synthesize any hormone?
(Posterior pituitary koi hormone kyun nahi banata?)
blocks.explanation: Posterior pituitary mein hypothalamus se aane wale axons hote hain. Yeh sirf hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells ke banaye hormones (ADH, oxytocin) jama aur kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: The posterior pituitary contains axons that originate in hypothalamus and extend to posterior pituitary

blocks.prompt:
27 Why do the hypothalamus and posterior pituitary remain connected by a tract of axons?
(Hypothalamus aur posterior pituitary axons ke tract se kyun jure rehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke embryo ki nashonuma mein posterior pituitary neural tissue ke ubhar se banta hai.

book_ref.quote: That’s why, hypothalamus of brain and posterior pituitary remain interconnected by a tract of axons

blocks.prompt:
28 Why does the uterus of a nursing mother return to normal size more quickly?
(Doodh pilane wali maa ka uterus jaldi normal size par kyun aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Oxytocin uterus ko sukerhta hai. Doodh pilane wali maaon mein wiladat ke baad bhi is ka ikhraj jari rehta hai, is liye in ka uterus jaldi normal size par aata hai.

book_ref.quote: It also stimulates uterine contractions in women during childbirth

blocks.prompt:
29 Describe the location and shape of the thyroid gland.
(Thyroid gland ki jagah aur shakal bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Thyroid titli numa gland hai jo gardan ke saamne trachea ke dono taraf hai. Yeh do jure hue lobes par mushtamil hai.

book_ref.quote: It is composed of two connected lobes

blocks.prompt:
30 Differentiate between T₄ and T₃.
(T₄ aur T₃ mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono thyroid ke hormones hain.

book_ref.quote: Thyroid produces much more T₄, which eventually converts into T₃

rows: Tetra-iodothyronine
Tri-iodothyronine
Bohat zyada miqdar mein banta hai
T₄ ke T₃ mein badalne se banta hai
Kam active
Zyada active aur taqatwar
Metabolism ki raftar control karta hai
Jism ki hararat aur dil ki dharkan regulate karta hai

blocks.prompt:
31 Write any four functions of T₄ and T₃.
(T₄ aur T₃ ke koi chaar kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Dil ki dharkan aur saans ki raftar barhate hain.
2. Cellular respiration tez karte aur basal metabolic rate tay karte hain.
3. Liver mein glucose catabolism aur cholesterol banna tez karte hain.
4. Bachon mein dhanche ki growth aur dimagh ki nashonuma.

book_ref.quote: They stimulate cellular respiration and set the body’s basal metabolic rate

blocks.prompt:
32 What is Graves' disease? Write its symptoms.
(Graves' disease kya hai? Is ki alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik autoimmune marz jo hyperthyroidism karta hai, aksar thyroid barh jata hai. Alamaat: chirchirapan, muscles ki kamzori, neend ke masail, tez dharkan, garmi bardasht na hona, dast, wazan kam hona, pindli ki jild moti; aankhein bahar ubhar sakti hain (exophthalmia).

book_ref.quote: is an autoimmune disease that causes hyperthyroidism

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between cretinism and myxoedema.
(Cretinism aur myxoedema mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono hypothyroidism se hote hain.

book_ref.quote: it causes cretinism i.e., a condition of stunted growth and mental retardation

rows: Janeen aur bachpan mein hypothyroidism
Shadeed hypothyroidism
Ruki hui growth aur zehni pasmandgi
Connective tissues mein mucopolysaccharides jama hona, jis se jild aur tissues sooj kar mote hote hain

blocks.prompt:
34 What is goitre? What causes it?
(Goitre kya hai? Yeh kis wajah se hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Goitre thyroid gland ki sujan hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab hypothyroidism iodine ki kami se ho.

book_ref.quote: If hypothyroidism is caused by iodine deficiency, it results in goitre

blocks.prompt:
35 How does parathormone raise blood calcium level? Give three ways.
(Parathormone khoon ka calcium kaise barhata hai? Teen tareeqe likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Osteoclasts se bone matrix ke calcium crystals ghulwa kar calcium khoon mein chhorta hai.
2. Gurdon se peshab ka calcium wapas jazb karwata hai.
3. Vitamin D ko active karta hai jo aant mein calcium jazb karne ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: It also stimulates the kidneys to reabsorb calcium from the urine

blocks.prompt:
36 Differentiate between hypercalcemia and hypocalcaemia.
(Hypercalcemia aur hypocalcaemia mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono parathormone ke bigar se hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Under secretion of parathormone causes hypocalcaemia

rows: Parathormone ki zyadti (tumour ho sakta hai)
Parathormone ki kami
Khoon ka calcium zyada
Khoon ka calcium kam
Nervous system susti; muscles kamzor
Neurons ki tezi barhti hai
Haddiyan tehri aur naram
Tetany ho sakta hai (muscles sukre rehte hain)

blocks.prompt:
37 What are islets of Langerhans?
(Islets of Langerhans kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pancreas mein zyada tar exocrine cells hain magar khas endocrine cells tukron ki shakal mein bhi hain jinhein islets of Langerhans kehte hain. Har islet mein beta cells (insulin) aur alpha cells (glucagon) hain.

book_ref.quote: These cells are distributed in the form of patches in the pancreas

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between glycogenesis and gluconeogenesis.
(Glycogenesis aur gluconeogenesis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono pancreas aur adrenal hormones ke kaamon mein aate hain.

book_ref.quote: It also promotes glycogenesis (conversion of glucose to glycogen) in liver

rows: Glucose ka glycogen banna
Glucose banna (maslan amino acids se)
Insulin liver mein barhata hai
Insulin rokta hai; glucocorticoids liver mein barhate hain

blocks.prompt:
39 What is hypoglycaemia? Write its symptoms.
(Hypoglycaemia kya hai? Is ki alamaat likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Hypoglycaemia insulin ki zyadti se blood glucose ka normal se kam hona hai. Alamaat: susti, chakkar, ghabrahat aur shadeed haalat mein behoshi.

book_ref.quote: Symptoms of hypoglycaemia include lethargy, dizziness, nervousness

blocks.prompt:
40 Differentiate between Type I and Type II diabetes.
(Type I aur Type II diabetes mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono diabetes mellitus ki qismein hain.

book_ref.quote: The patients of Type II diabetes (non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus) have normal levels of insulin in their blood

rows: Insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus
Non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus
Insulin banane wale β cells nahi hote
Insulin normal, magar cells ki hassasiyat kam
Rozana insulin ke injections
Doosri dawaon, ghiza aur warzish se control

blocks.prompt:
41 Why is insulin given by injection and not by mouth? How is it produced?
(Insulin munh se kyun nahi, injection se kyun di jati hai? Yeh kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insulin peptide hormone hai; munh se lene par hazam ho jayegi, is liye injection se khoon mein di jati hai. Yeh genetically engineered bacteria banate hain.

book_ref.quote: because insulin is a peptide hormone, it would be digested if taken orally

blocks.prompt:
42 Why does diabetes mellitus lead to dehydration?
(Diabetes mellitus se pani ki kami kyun hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cells glucose nahi le pate, is liye blood glucose zyada rehta hai. Zaid glucose gurdon mein pani ka wapas jazb hona rokta hai, zyada peshab banta hai aur pani ki kami aur gurdon ko nuqsan hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It leads to dehydration and kidney damage

blocks.prompt:
43 Differentiate between adrenal cortex and adrenal medulla.
(Adrenal cortex aur adrenal medulla mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Yeh har adrenal gland ke do hisse hain.

book_ref.quote: Each gland is composed of an inner portion, the adrenal medulla, and an outer layer, the adrenal cortex

rows: Bahar wali teh
Andar wala hissa
Corticosteroids kharij karta hai
Epinephrine aur norepinephrine kharij karta hai
Anterior pituitary ke hormones ke control mein
Nervous system ke control mein

blocks.prompt:
44 Differentiate between glucocorticoids and mineralocorticoids.
(Glucocorticoids aur mineralocorticoids mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono adrenal cortex ke corticosteroids hain.

book_ref.quote: Mineralocorticoids e.g., aldosterone helps to regulate mineral balance in blood

rows: Misal cortisol
Misal aldosterone
Glucose ka tawazun
Khoon mein minerals ka tawazun
Muscle protein ko amino acids mein torna; liver mein gluconeogenesis
Gurde sodium (aur pani) wapas jazb aur zaid potassium kharij karte hain

blocks.prompt:
45 How does aldosterone maintain normal blood volume and pressure?
(Aldosterone khoon ki normal miqdar aur pressure kaise barqarar rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aldosterone gurdon se peshab ka sodium wapas jazb karwata hai. Sodium ke saath pani bhi wapas jazb hota hai, is tarah khoon ki miqdar aur pressure normal rehte hain.

book_ref.quote: In this way, water is also reabsorbed from urine

blocks.prompt:
46 Differentiate between Cushing disease and Addison's disease.
(Cushing disease aur Addison's disease mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cortisol ke bigar se hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Over secretion of cortisol from adrenal cortex causes Cushing disease

rows: Cortisol ki zyadti
Cortisol ki kami
Pituitary ke zyada ACTH banane se
Alamaat aam taur par aahista aati hain
Protein ka zyada tootna; zyada sugar aur BP, patli haddiyan, muscles ka ghatna, patli nazuk jild, udasi, auraton mein chehre par zyada baal
Aam metabolic bigar, muscles ki kamzori aur namak ka zaya hona

blocks.prompt:
47 What is the fight or flight response? Write its changes.
(Fight or flight response kya hai? Is ki tabdeeliyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pareshani mein adrenal medulla epinephrine aur norepinephrine kharij karta hai jo jism ko fight or flight ke liye tayyar karte hain: dil ki tez dharkan, BP zyada, bronchioles phailna, blood glucose barhna, aur jild va hazm ke organs ko khoon kam.

book_ref.quote: The hormones prepare the body for

blocks.prompt:
48 What are the effects of imbalance of adrenal medulla hormones?
(Adrenal medulla ke hormones ke bigar ke kya asraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Zyadti se rozmarra zindagi mein hypertension aur jarhana rawayya ho sakta hai. Kami se emergency ka muqabla nahi ho pata.

book_ref.quote: Over secretion of hormones of adrenal medulla may cause hypertension and aggressive behaviour during routine life

blocks.prompt:
49 What are gonads? Under which hormones do they produce sex hormones?
(Gonads kya hain? Yeh kin hormones ke asar se sex hormones banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gonads (auraton mein ovaries, mardon mein testes) gametes banane wale organs hain. Yeh anterior pituitary ke LH aur FSH ke asar se sex hormones bhi banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Gonads (ovaries in females and testes in males) are gamete-producing organs

blocks.prompt:
50 What is puberty? Write two changes each in males and females.
(Puberty kya hai? Mardon aur auraton mein do do tabdeeliyan likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Puberty (baloghat) naujawani ka woh marhala hai jis mein sex organs pakte aur secondary sex khususiyaat zahir hoti hain. Mard: sperm banna shuru, awaz bhari (seena chaura, baal). Aurat: menstrual cycle shuru, chhaatiyan barhti hain (koolhe chaure).

book_ref.quote: Puberty is the adolescent stage during which the sex organs mature and secondary sex characteristics appear

blocks.prompt:
51 How does progesterone help maintain pregnancy?
(Progesterone hamal barqarar rakhne mein kaise madad deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh uterus ki deewar ko mazeed mota aur khoon ki naliyon se bhar deta hai. Mazeed FSH rok kar follicles ko pakne nahi deta aur ovulation dabata hai. Hamal mein placenta bhi ise kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: It causes further thickening and vascularisation of the uterus wall for maintaining pregnancy

blocks.prompt:
52 What are androgens? Write the functions of testosterone.
(Androgens kya hain? Testosterone ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Androgens LH ke asar se testes ke kharij karda sex hormones ka group hain. Testosterone (interstitial cells se) mardana organs pakata, secondary sex khususiyaat aur jinsi khwahish laata aur normal sperm ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: LH stimulates the testes to secrete a group of sex hormones called androgens

blocks.prompt:
53 What are the effects of estrogen deficiency and over-secretion?
(Estrogen ki kami aur zyadti ke kya asraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Naujawan larkiyon mein kami: jinsi taur par na pakna; baalighon mein: banjhpan. Zyadti se uterus mein fibroids aur polycystic ovaries ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: Due to estrogen deficiency in the young females, they fail to mature sexually

blocks.prompt:
54 What are the effects of under-secretion of progesterone and of testosterone?
(Progesterone aur testosterone ki kami ke kya asraat hain?)
blocks.explanation: Progesterone: menstrual cycle mein hamal ka imkan kam aur jaldi menstruation; hamal mein miscarriage. Testosterone (mard): zanana khususiyaat aur mardana banjhpan.

book_ref.quote: Under secretion of progesterone during menstrual cycle, decreases the chance of pregnancy and may cause early menstruation

blocks.prompt:
55 What are anabolic steroids? Why do athletes use them?
(Anabolic steroids kya hain? Khiladi inhein kyun istemal karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Anabolic steroids testosterone ki masnooi shakal hain. Khiladi inhein is liye lete hain ke yeh muscles, taqat aur bardasht barhate hain; khel mein in ka istemal ghair qanooni aur mamnoo hai.

book_ref.quote: They increase muscle mass, strength, and endurance

blocks.text: 16.2.8 Other Endocrine Glands/Tissues (printed '16.2.8.' with trailing dot)

blocks.prompt:
56 Where is the thymus gland located? Write the function of its hormone.
(Thymus gland kahan hai? Is ke hormone ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Thymus sternum ke neeche aur lungs ke darmiyan hai. Yeh thymosin kharij karta hai jo T cells ko pakata hai jo jism ko pathogens se bachate hain.

book_ref.quote: Thymus gland is located beneath the sternum and between the lungs

blocks.prompt:
57 Differentiate between gastrin and secretin.
(Gastrin aur secretin mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono digestive organs ke hormones hain jo hazm ko control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Endocrine cells of the small intestine wall release secretin hormone that stimulates the pancreas to release pancreatic juice

rows: Khana khane par maide ki deewar ke endocrine cells se
Small intestine ki deewar ke endocrine cells se
Gastric glands se gastric juice nikalwata hai
Pancreas se pancreatic juice nikalwata hai

blocks.prompt:
58 Name three hormones of the kidneys and write their functions.
(Gurdon ke teen hormones ke naam aur kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Renin: adrenal glands mein aldosterone ki paidawar control karta hai.
2. Erythropoietin: bone marrow se RBCs banwata hai.
3. Calcitriol: aant se calcium jazb karwa kar khoon ka calcium barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: Kidneys also produce erythropoietin hormone that stimulates bone marrow for the production of RBCs

blocks.prompt:
59 What are endorphins and prostaglandins?
(Endorphins aur prostaglandins kya hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Endorphins: dimagh ke hormones jo dard ke receptors se jur kar dard ka ehsas rokte hain.
Prostaglandins: taqreeban tamam cells ke banaye hormone jaise maddy; taqatwar maqami vasodilators jo inflammation mein shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Brain produces hormones called endorphins

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Khas endocrine cells dimagh, maide, small intestine, liver aur doosre organs mein hain; gurde bhi hormones banate hain.

book_ref.quote: There are also specialized endocrine cells in brain, stomach, small intestine, liver, and other organs

blocks.prompt:
61 Define feedback mechanism.
(Feedback mechanism ki tareef karein.)
blocks.explanation: Feedback mechanism woh amal hai jis mein control karne wala nizam khud usi amal ki paidawar se control hota hai jise woh control kar raha hai. Endocrine system bhi aise nizam se control hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Endocrine system also has feedback mechanisms, which control it

blocks.prompt:
62 Why is the release of oxytocin during childbirth called positive feedback?
(Wiladat ke dauran oxytocin ka ikhraj positive feedback kyun kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uterus ke sukerne se hypothalamus oxytocin chhorta hai; oxytocin zyada aur taqatwar sukerhaw laata hai jo mazeed oxytocin chhurwata hai. Jawab nizam ko tez karta hai, bache ki paidaish tak.

book_ref.quote: Hypothalamus triggers the release of oxytocin from posterior pituitary

blocks.prompt:
63 How is insulin release stopped by negative feedback?
(Negative feedback se insulin ka ikhraj kaise band hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blood glucose normal se zyada ho to beta cells insulin chhorte hain jo glucose kam karti hai. Natija, yani normal glucose, beta cells ko insulin band karne ka ishara deta hai; aakhri paidawar pehla qadam rok deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Negative feedback is common in endocrine system
